front.title: Multiple Ephemeral UDP Source Ports for ESP in UDP Encapsulation (MUSE)

abstract.t: This document specifies a mechanism to improve network path distribution and host receive-queue load distribution for IPsec traffic using ESP in UDP encapsulation [RFC3948]. Using the per- resource Child SA mechanism of [RFC9611], peers negotiate multiple Child SAs each bound to a distinct UDP source port. The resulting entropy in the UDP source port enables network devices to distribute per-resource traffic across distinct paths (equal-cost multi-path, ECMP) and lets the host NIC steer each per-resource flow to a distinct receive queue via receive-side scaling (RSS), supporting efficient per-CPU IPsec processing. This document specifies the IKEv2 negotiation, NAT traversal behavior, and operational requirements for this mechanism.
